insights.text: In the recent 20 trades, cautious-regime shorts went 1/8 (12% WR), with 5 full stops and near-zero MFE on failures. The regime label "cautious" is not filtering adequately — shorts are being taken anyway. ACTION: In cautious regime, require MFE signal (price must move 0.3R toward target before committing mentally) or skip shorts entirely unless confluence is 3/4 AND volume confirmed is present.

Recent risk_on shorts were 3/5 (60% WR) with clean T2 hits, but the 2 losses had MFE ≤ 0.23R — essentially immediate reversals. ACTION: In risk_on regime, skip short setups where MFE at entry bar is near zero; only take shorts with prior session showing clear lower-high structure. Do not fade momentum blindly.

ADAUSDT shorts appeared 5 times in recent 20 trades with 1/5 WR. Despite lifetime edge (16/37 overall), it is being over-traded intraday — multiple setups per run dilute quality. ACTION: Cap ADAUSDT at 1 short setup per run. If it appears twice, take only the higher-ranked one.

Lifetime rank 2 is 29/84 (35% WR, +0.04 avg R:R) — the only rank with positive RR sum (+3.46R). Rank 1 is 26/93 (28% WR, -0.20 avg R:R). ACTION: When forced to choose between two similar setups, prefer rank 2 over rank 1. Do not auto-promote a setup to rank 1 solely on confluence score.

`wait_for_retest` rule appears in 3 trades: 0/3 WR, -0.63 avg blended R:R. Trades using it show low MFE (0.18–0.82R) and fail to reach T1. ACTION: Remove `wait_for_retest` as a standalone justification. If a retest is needed, wait for it to complete before logging the setup — do not pre-log a setup pending retest.
